Wholesale ordering in Telegram for dealers and shops

Shop clients order even at night and see their own prices and balance, so agents stop collecting orders by phone. An MVP in 4–6 weeks, from UZS 54 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes

What the full version adds
  • Reconciliation statements in the bot
